      public String printGraduatingStudents(Schedule schedule)
      Returns students who meet the 120-credit graduation requirement, ordered by major.

    • printTuition

      public String printTuition(Schedule schedule)
      Returns a tuition report ordered by student profile. Lists each enrolled section then the total tuition due. International non-study-abroad students with less than 12 credits receive an error message.
      Parameters:
      schedule - the schedule used to look up each student's enrolled sections and credits
      Returns:
      String containing the full tuition report, or a message if no students exist
